$comment: The register of every seeded generator: shipped salts and cutover tables are frozen facts here, so a change in code shows up as a checker failure. Read by check-determinism.mjs (paths) and check-golden-vectors.mjs. An app with no seeded generator keeps "generators": [].

generators.$comment: Template values: salt 795560989 is the template's 0x2f6b4c1d; before the first release set it to the generator's new salt (in decimal) and refill the template rows (Workflow step 6). outcome.file is the persistence layout's repository port; point it at whichever file declares the stored row once the table exists.
